title: Comparing Shapes and Quantities
goal: Explore comparing Shapes and Quantities at a comfortable, adaptable level.
readiness: Child counts quantities reliably up to 20.
steps: Fill two identical short, wide glasses with equal colored water.
Ask child to confirm equality.
Pour one glass into a tall, narrow glass in front of child.
Ask: 'Does one have more, or do they still have the same amount? Why?'.
Encourage reversible reasoning: 'What happens if we pour it back?'.
completionCriteria: Child compares quantities and explains an idea with demonstrations; no stage-of-development diagnosis is made.
safety: Use shatterproof plastic glasses and safe food coloring.
adaptations: Use shorter attempts, accessible materials or additional support.
